description: This file defines a PHP trait `RetryHelperTrait` which provides helper methods related to retry logic in AWS SDK operations, such as adding retry headers, updating retry statistics, and binding transfer statistics to response objects.

methods.name: addRetryHeader
methods.description: Adds an AWS SDK retry header to the request with the current retry count and delay.

methods.name: updateStats
methods.description: Updates the total retry delay and retries attempted counters in the stats array.

methods.name: updateHttpStats
methods.description: Updates HTTP transfer statistics based on either an AwsException or a ResultInterface object.

methods.name: bindStatsToReturn
methods.description: Associates accumulated retry and transfer stats with the return object, which may be a ResultInterface or AwsException.
